tax.text: On her campaign site she pledges to cut the gas tax, tolls, fees and other taxes to lower the cost of living.
tax.quote: I will fight to lower the cost of living by reducing the gas tax, cutting tolls, streamlining permitting, and eliminating fees and taxes that burden families and small businesses.

housing.text: Her issues page calls for reforming codes and regulations to lower costs and expand housing options.
housing.quote: Common-sense reforms to codes and regulations can lower costs and expand housing options while maintaining safety.

schools.text: Her campaign site says she would expand school choice and defend parental rights, alongside improving public schools.
schools.quote: I will expand educational opportunities and school choice, defend parental rights, improve access to IEPs

safety.text: Callison says she would promote safer communities through stronger mental health services.
safety.quote: promote safer communities with stronger mental health services

cannabis.text: Her issues page supports federal legalization and lighter regulation to grow the cannabis industry.
cannabis.quote: Lower fees, fair regulations, and federal legalization can grow the cannabis industry and create opportunity.
